name: You
text: I need an RTX 5070 Ti under $1,400 by Friday.

name: Fish Market Buyer
text: Reading your goal: one RTX 5070 Ti under $1,400 by Friday.

name: Fish Market Buyer
text: 4 sealed bids in. No seller sees your budget. Round 1 now.

name: Shield
text: Blocked Seller 2: hidden instructions aimed at the buying agent.

name: Advocate
text: Is it new, open-box, refurbished or used?

name: Referee
text: Winner: Best Buy listing at $1,299.99. Above the allowance, so the buyer gets a call with the code.

name: Fish Market Buyer
text: Bought the ASUS Prime RTX 5070 Ti OC from Best Buy for $1,299.99 before tax. Two offers were out on price, one was blocked by the Shield, and one failed the fit check. Approved by your phone code.
